task_plan.user_request: Verify the Arduino 3.3V pin outputs correct voltage per datasheet specs
task_plan.description: Measures the DC voltage on the +3V3 OUT pin of the Arduino Uno Q board and verifies it against the specified range of 3.1V to 3.5V, as per the 'arduino_uno_q' datasheet.

setup.notes: Ensure the Arduino Uno Q board is powered on before starting the test.

steps.description: Move the robotic arm to a safe, home position above the DUT.
steps.pass_criteria: Robot arm is in safe position.

steps.description: Wait for 5 seconds for any residual vibrations to settle.
Position the positive multimeter probe onto the +3V3 OUT pin (JANALOG, Pin 4) on the Arduino Uno Q board.
Position the negative multimeter probe onto an accessible GND pin on the Arduino Uno Q board.

parameters.probe_negative: any accessible GND pin on DUT

steps.description: Measure the DC voltage between the +3V3 OUT pin and GND.
Verify the measured voltage is within the specified range of 3.1V to 3.5V.
Report the measured voltage and the verification result.
Retract both multimeter probes from the DUT and move the robotic arm to a safe home position.
steps.pass_criteria: Robot arm is in safe home position.

critical_checks: Verification of +3V3 OUT pin voltage against datasheet specifications (3.1V - 3.5V).
